RAW + OIS and RAW + OIS + flash modules for X6810-GL, packaged independently of GCam.
RAW accepts Android 11+ with verified vendor binaries. Flash uses the exact
Android 16 GSI profile. Historical device evidence is Android 16 GSI only;
new packaging is validated offline. Telephoto OIS and external BSG V32 with the recommended V32 profile were tested and work correctly on Android 16 GSI. RAW also includes processed HD48 JPEG. Combined flash APIs require API 35; the current ELF profile remains API 36.
See docs/COMPATIBILITY.md and the separate GCam repository:
https://github.com/SRE-0/infinix_x6810_gcam_port

English documentation with linked Spanish editions. Experimental software provided as-is; responsibility is excluded only to the extent permitted by law. Read DISCLAIMER.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
